about: S-admin-moderation - Moderacio (the compact STATISZTIKA panel above the queue) and the Statistics page. Captured LIVE against a scratch backend (own port, throwaway encrypted DB seeded by seed:dev-users, seed:exercises and seed:demo): `node scripts/pulse-shot.mjs --package S-admin-moderation --live --api http://localhost:3923 --serve . --port 5223`. The empty queue, the error and the loading state are edits or stubs over / instead of the live answers; nothing is recorded into the freeze and no write is ever fired. Account A = admin@.
